Title: Invitation to the seminar on multilingual RAG evaluation

Hello,

The next NEXUS seminar will take place on 10 September at 12:00 and will focus on multilingual evaluation of RAG systems. The session will be hybrid and delivered in English.

The speaker will present protocols for evaluating retrieval, faithfulness, completeness, and cross-language consistency. This will be followed by a discussion of how these criteria can be applied to the ARIADNA benchmark.

I have attached the provisional program and attendance form. The session will be recorded only if the speaker's permission is received in advance; audience contributions will not be published without explicit consent.

Best regards,
Lucía
